title: OutcomeBound source manifest v1
description: What `outcomebound sources import` writes: the items of one or more markdown or plain-text files. An item's id is where it stands (name:file:section); its revision is the sha256 of its text, so a changed item keeps its id and shows a new revision. The manifest holds the source text. It has no timestamp: one input gives one file.

partial.description: True where any item is partial.

file.description: The path as given, relative to the folder the import ran in, else the file's name.

raw_sha256.description: sha256 of the file's bytes with CRLF as LF.

bytes.description: The size of the file with CRLF as LF.

converted.description: The text was converted from another format; the conversion's fidelity is unverified.

partial.description: Why the item may not hold all its source's text; empty where nothing was observed.

suspect.description: Advisory flags from the instruction audit's lexical classes; empty is not safe.
